reference.zone: les deux figures de gauche (face, trois-quarts)

planche.prompt: The Smiling One, an emaciated, unnaturally tall and thin humanoid with an overly long neck and a too-round head. Its face is hidden behind a white porcelain mask with a wide fixed smile and narrow eye slits, strapped tight onto the head. Pale grey-pink skin stretched over visible ribs and knobbly joints, long bony fingers. It wears a torn hooded tunic of rotten brown linen hanging in strips to the knees, a rope belt with small leather pouches, cloth wraps around the shins, bare feet. Vertical, thin silhouette; the white mask is the brightest thing on it.

source.prompt: A thin figure dancing slowly in place with stiff, jerky arm movements, swaying the torso from side to side and lightly stamping the feet, looping smoothly back to the starting pose.

clips.note: §8.10 Rituel : danse en synchronie parfaite ; §18 : la phase commune vient du moteur, le clip boucle

source.prompt: Standing in place and swinging an imaginary scythe low and wide from right to left in a slow, steady harvesting rhythm, returning to the starting pose to loop.
Crouching low, repeatedly picking something up from the ground with both hands and bringing it to the mouth, hunched over, looping smoothly.

clips.note: L7 : la tête pivote d'un coup sec vers le joueur en 0,4 s (TUNING.alertTurnTicks) ; rotation procédurale de l'os de la tête par le moteur, pas de clip

source.prompt: Running forward with the upper body perfectly upright and motionless, arms hanging still at the sides, while the legs move unnaturally fast with short quick strides, looping.

clips.note: §8.10 : buste immobile, jambes trop rapides ; foulée calée sur 4,5 m/s

source.prompt: Lunging bite: the head first tilts sharply sideways by ninety degrees, then the upper body snaps forward leading with the head as if biting, then pulls back to an upright stance.

clips.note: §8.10 : morsure en fente, télégraphe 0,4 s où la tête bascule à 90° (§18) ; repère d'impact calé sur le tick actif
L7 : petite créature, interrompue par n'importe quel coup ; la réaction coupe l'attaque en 2 images
L1 : à 0 de Chair elle tombe Abattue ; tombe sur le dos, d'où il rampe (§8.10)
§8.10 : Abattu, il garde son sourire et rampe sur le dos ; L1 : 0,8 m/s vers le support

clips.note: L1 : sans support à portée, elle se tord sur place ; §18 : tout ce qui vit tremble
